description: This file defines function prototypes and macros for dealing with HTTP status codes, HTTP methods, and HTTP versions in the lighttpd server. It provides external API declarations for converting status codes and methods to strings and vice versa.

methods.name: li_http_status_string
methods.description: Returns a string description for a given HTTP status code and sets the length of the string.

methods.name: li_http_method_from_string
methods.description: Returns the enum value of an HTTP method matching the given string.

methods.name: li_http_method_string
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method as a string and sets the length.

methods.name: li_http_version_string
methods.description: Returns the HTTP version as a string and sets the length.

methods.name: li_http_status_to_str
methods.description: Converts a given HTTP status code to a 3-character string representation.
